contract.atomicFactSet: complete `ProcurementRunExecutionBasis@1` + prospective Run identity + `ResponsibilityControlCommitHandle` + current Field/Profile Hint/Access/terminal Observation/Policy/active Triage Rule authority/Material/Selection/Control fence + Run及relationized Basis rows + 全部`run_selection` guard + 对全部成员的同Field Procurement Control acquire/assert + durable `ProcurementControlReceipt` + commit marker；Profile Hint Snapshot必须逐字节命中current Field pointer、精确immutable revision row及terminal Observation冻结值；每个Selection member必须从同事务current Field Material row冻结完整Physical Identity四元组与size，写入`proc_run_materials`并纳入Basis member digest，不能只保留不可逆materialKey/摘要；Triage Rule必须由注入的Procurement Registry解析并匹配当前active snapshot，不能信任调用者值；`hasOutbox=false`，全部事实/Control全有或全无，禁止分批Control后补建Run
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Execution Basis验证前后、active Triage Rule解析前后、逐成员Selection/Control fence重验、Run/Basis rows写入、Control acquire/assert、typed Result/marker前后、响应前崩溃
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: 完整Basis、Run、全部run_selection、同Field Procurement Control和ProcurementControlReceipt全有或全无；Rule只能来自注入的Procurement Registry；任一成员stale或冲突整体rollback；不写Outbox
